# grader note: not `wrong question` — the judged state holds a.txt and b.txt, which the card calls durable (claims 1-2); nothing the card calls scratch is judged, and setup/check live outside `state/` so the apparatus is not mixed into the judgement. Converting two files in one operation does not contradict claim 2, which is per-file old-or-new.

# grader note: `unresolved by card` chosen because the card assigns this exact fork in advance — a define declaring `d2utmp*` scratch respects claim 4 and is valid; one that turns on the leftover temporary is unresolved rather than wrong. This define is not the former.
